scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory server alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:server: pnpm run db:migrate && uv run --directory server fastapi dev app/main.py --port 9200
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:admin && rm -rf server/static server/static-admin && cp -r web/dist server/static && cp -r web-admin/dist server/static-admin
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:prod && pnpm run start:prod
